title: Delhi HC orders Centre to explain why political cartoonist’s Instagram account was blocked in India
summary:
Gaurav Yadav's verified Instagram account has around 68,500 followers but remains inaccessible to users in India following a government restriction.

The post Delhi HC orders Centre to explain why political cartoonist’s Instagram account was blocked in India appeared first on MEDIANAMA.
llm_summary: Delhi’s High Court has asked the Indian government to explain why the verified Instagram profile of political cartoonist Gaurav Yadav—who has about 68,500 followers—has been blocked for users in India. The restriction, imposed by a government order, makes the account inaccessible nationwide despite its public popularity. The court’s directive seeks clarification on the legal basis for the ban.
